name: Mandarin orange (Clementine, Tangerine) (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Mandarin orange (Clementine, Tangerine) (Citrus reticulata) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169105 (SR Legacy: Tangerines, mandarin oranges, raw) - full sugar/amino-acid/vitamin/mineral/fatty-acid panel

Cano-Lamadrid et al. / triploid late-season mandarin juice study (Food Research International, S0963996912002840): mandarin juice organic acids citric 8.53-13.18 g/L, malic 447.76-902.48 mg/L, ascorbic 286.82-389.02 mg/L, oxalic 47.04-98.03 mg/L
Springer Tangerine (Citrus reticulata) chapter doi:10.1007/978-3-031-37534-7_6: Clementine/Satsuma titratable acidity 0.6-1.0% as citric; citric = 85-90% of total organic acids
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for a growth medium are the free sugars (sucrose ~6.1, fructose ~2.4, glucose ~2.1 g/100g) plus citric acid (~0.9 g/100g, the mandarin's principal organic acid and the key metabolite missing from the FooDB profile, which carried only L-malate). Removed 11 FooDB noise/contaminant entries (arsenate, ethynylestradiol, epsilon-polylysine, Al/Si/B/Ni/Co/Cr/Mo trace elements, erythro-isoleucine artifact). coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
